overview_description.description: Weelo provides a sales and distribution solution powered by AI that assists SMEs in managing multiple sales channels from warehouse to cash collection. Weelo enables trading partners (manufacturers, suppliers, distributors) to connect, communicate, and transact with retailers in real time using automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and predictive analytics.
